description: A singleton created with the class, with a `name` and a `value`; compare members with `is`.
Classmethod called when a value lookup fails; return a member to accept the value or `None` to raise `ValueError`.
Members are also strings (Python 3.11+); `auto()` uses the lowercase member name as the value.
Members are bits combined with `|`, `&`, `^`, `~`; `in` tests containment and iteration yields single-bit members.
A name bound to the value of an existing member or combination, such as `ADMIN`; iteration over the class skips it.
Members are ints, so they equal plain ints and members of other int enums with the same value.
